caption:
Swipe through these. 💰 Robinhood's CEO just said tokenization will eat the entire financial system, and these 6 AI prompts prepare your business tonight.

Prompt 1 gets Claude to explain the whole shift in plain English for your specific business type, Prompt 2 maps every payment risk you carry and tells you which are urgent, Prompt 3 writes the brief your accountant needs before your next meeting, Prompt 4 finds where your current payment setup breaks first and builds a backup plan, Prompt 5 gives you a 90-day plan to move first on the shift, Prompt 6 writes the calm customer email you will need before payments ever change.

When the CEO of one of America's biggest financial apps calls it a supercycle, the question is who prepared and who didn't. These prompts do the work your consultant hasn't started yet. Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Robinhood, Vlad Tenev
